svg.text: The struct editor — every kind of field, the list forms, entities, errors (DESIGN_Struct_Editor.md)
Scope: the value side of the one table (Fill mode). Define mode adds Name / Type cells — field-editor-visual.svg. Grey notes are not drawn.
Details — AI — Ambush (FILL — one table, every kind)
the entity no longer exists — pick another or Clear
'3x' is not a whole number — the value stays 3
⌖ teal = show on map (hover previews, click pins) · ⊕ = pick on the map · ▾ = the picker (search · map · key · clear)
grey value = the default · amber bar + ↺ = changed · a closed structure says what changed or shows its summary
flags = toggle chips on one row · optional = a 'set' box · an error keeps the typed text and the old value
Lists — the form follows the element (B1–B6)
B1 short list of words / numbers — inline chips
B2 list of structures — one SUMMARY row per item
⋮ = Insert above / below · Duplicate · Move · Delete
B3 small flat structures — a GRID (columns = fields)
grid ⇄ rows: a setting per type (≤ 4 plain fields)
B4 fixed size — slots, no add / remove
B5 polymorphic — the kind picked when adding
B6 long list — filter and pages
a list over 50 items starts closed and pages; the filter matches the item summary
By key (@name) — follows whoever holds the key
type-ahead over names · side colour · kind glyph · distance from the selection
a field's [MapPickableEntity] presets narrow the list (infantry only, …)
Details — Unit — Alpha 1-1 (an entity FORM: FormDecl rows, the SAME widgets)
the SAME FormGrid rows · the SAME entity chip and picker · the SAME list block, item menu and error line —
FormView keeps its declared rows (R-4120); only its hand-made buttons go
The ONE widget kit (NodeEditor.Core.Widgets) — and its ImGui cost
B2 B5 B6 summary rows, ⋮, Add ▾
changed bar + ↺ · error line · set box
drag is a BONUS: the ⋮ menu and Alt+↑/↓ always move an item
